question: Is there a real observed problem here
panel: Cohort lead plus one operating-cell lead
pass_condition_summary: Three independent recorded instances; not already solved by an existing venture; a named participant wants to own it

question: Should this business exist and is this the founder
panel: Country operating lead plus venture architect plus external technical assessor
required_artifacts: Venture charter; demand evidence pack; founder record extract; anti-extraction pre-check; lane check
pass_condition_summary: Five named prospective customers interviewed with revealed willingness to pay distinguished from stated; founder record supports responsibility; fits a catalogued track; no unlabelled ASSUMPTION or CONFLICT; Marine Foundation lane not implicated
common_kill: Founder ready and demand absent or vice versa

question: Do the operations and economics work
panel: G2 panel plus finance and risk reviewer plus data-rights reviewer
required_artifacts: Unit economics with evidence-classed inputs; operating design; shared-services plan; data-rights draft; risk register; capital plan
pass_condition_summary: Economics positive at a defensible price or a stated tested assumption; pricing traces to approved evidence; data-rights drafted; regulatory pathway identified in-country; loss-bearing party named and agreed
common_kill: Economics need volume nobody has evidence for

question: Does it exist and function safely at small scale
panel: Country operating lead plus quality-assurance lead plus safety assessor
required_artifacts: Live operating cell; HAMAL tenant; credentialed crew; SOPs; safety clearance; first work orders
pass_condition_summary: SOPs demonstrated not just written; every operator credentialed; tenant live with work logged at point of work; consent capture functioning; stop-loss and wind-down plan exists
common_kill: One qualified person and three helpers

question: Does it hold up with real customers under real pressure
panel: Governance body including a member independent of the venture and the foundry commercial interest
required_artifacts: Bounded pilot charter with stop-loss; realised metrics; realised unit economics; customer records
pass_condition_summary: Metrics meet the published bar over a defined period; realised economics support continuation; no unresolved safety or governance incident; records complete consented and venture-owned; founder record supports the ownership pathway; the pilot changed the design
common_kill: Metrics work only with the founder personally doing the hard part

question: Is this a governed durable business
required_artifacts: Quarterly performance and governance review; contribution ledger; scorecard contribution; standards compliance; successor development; data-rights audit
pass_condition_summary: Maintained not granted; may be returned to V4 on deterioration
common_kill: Governance decay after launch attention fades
